entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We all agreed on that, right?[n]We still haven't finished it.
entries.uk: Ми ж усі на нього погодилися?[n]А досі не виконали.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't know when the next[n]big target will show up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's take care of it.[n]We can get some exercise too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh yeah, we still haven't finished[n]Mishima's request.
entries.uk: А, точно, ми ще не виконали[n]прохання Місіми.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we're going to Mementos, will you[n]have everyone gather at the hideout?
entries.uk: Якщо йдемо в Мементос, збереш[n]усіх у схованці?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Cool! Let's meet up at the hideout!
